name: wow-addon-workspace
description: Claude Code plugins for writing and maintaining World of Warcraft addons.

plugins.name: wow-addon-dev
plugins.description: A WoW addon workspace for Claude Code: declare your addons, create new ones from a template, check them before a commit (Lua 5.1 syntax, .toc, size, translations, headless tests), and give Claude the API facts measured on WoW: Forever plus agents that look APIs up in Blizzard's UI source and review a diff for known traps.
